name: @moya/emulate-github
description: Local GitHub release pull request smoke test

scripts.docker:shell: docker compose exec github-emulator bash -c 'export GH_TOKEN="$TOKEN" GH_ENTERPRISE_TOKEN="$TOKEN"; exec bash -i'
scripts.docker:cert: mkdir -p .local && docker compose exec -T github-proxy cat /data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt > .local/emulator-ca.crt
